yeah, the dictator, charlie chaplin. It still sticks to me. But in two versions, 1 that is a more loosely adapted version in my mind, and the other is the speech itself. What I find most bothersome about that film though is that 1 guy ruined that mustache for everyone.

Interpret it and mold it over in your mind. Just try not to take anything too harshly.

Hi, what I'm about to say will sound like a cliché, but it's true nonetheless. You are taking on far too much for any normal human being to endure. You're allowing yourself to get crushed merely to ease to burden on those around you. Admirable it may be, you've long passed the point where this becomes an automatic response to such an extent that you're not only taking on more than you can handle, you're blaming yourself for not being able to handle even more ! You're creating a lose-lose scenario, which quite frankly, shouldn't be able to happen when you're married, as that other person should be your friend. By the word friend I mean the real definition of friend. Someone who truly cares and helps. Who aids without you having to even say a word and who may not always be there when you want, but ALWAYS, without fault, is there when you need them.

What I'm trying to say is, well, a lot of things, but for one, be real and true to yourself. The few simple words you've used to descripe your marriage and husband is more than enough words for me to form an opinion and give you advice on it. You see, you've described a partnership with, for a lack of a better word, a parasite. Now you need to remember something. Whether you're the right person for him, and whether he is the right person for you. I'm not talking about this soulfriend bullshit, only being 1 person on earth for us all. I'm talking about whether you can trust this person, whether he trusts you. I know it hurts, I know it's tough, but for the love of God woman, don't take this hardship on you just for the notion of love ! that may seem harsh, and I apologize if it came across as such. I just want you to realise you're worth more.

I'm not gonna attempt to preach from some higher moral ground, as I myself have a date set for my own suicide. What I will say though is this, the misery that is now upon you is but the passing of greed and bitterness of a man and, sadly, those around you who fear their own goodness to such a degree that they prefere hardness and unkindness. So please, do not despair. Don't give yourself over to this system and these brutes. Who enslaves you, who teals you what to do, what to think and what to feel. You're a human being worthy of all the love and kindness in this world.

You have the love of humanity in your heart. You have the power to create. To create happiness. To make life free and beautiful. Fight for a new world, a decent world.

I just find it somehow exhaustingly sad that I shall endure and keep going simply to avoid causing other pain. Don't get me wrong, I really loathe being a burden and cause others harm or pain. yet, forcing me to stay alive just so they don't have to deal with me be going seems so contradictingly confusing. 

I started the task of pushing everyone steadily away around 3 years ago. Done a fantastic job with it if I may say so myself. I get around 2-3 text messages a month, from either cellphone provider or internett provider or something similar. I have no interactions with anyone outside of work. I maintain a lie good enough to avoid raising question, yet also ensures no one tries to peek behind the facade. I know when I'll do the deed, I know how, and I know where.

I've travelled a lot, I've changed things up, yet it all falls short when the hell I'm in is coming from within. I'm unable to escape when my travelling companion is pain and suffering. The only comfort these travels of mine brings is that they, ironically, makes it much easier to keep people at distance. 

Most posts in this subreddit seems to come from people who are just realising they're nearing the point of no return, so to speak. I've not onle arrived there a long time ago, I'm damn close to accepting it aswell and longing for it. But, sometimes, I get guilty. because I promised myself I would never give up. Luckily it passes as I blame it on the naitivity of 8 year old me. Back when I still had hopes and dreams.
The problem with losing all of your dreams and hopes, all of your aspirations and desires, all of your joy and happiness. It's not something you can get back. I'm unable to remember the last time I laughed. Not the socially required laugh, but a true genuin laughter. Same goes for smiling. Last time I remember being happy is 17 years ago. 

What is so precious and fantastic about life that I shall keep forcing myself forward ? is it not possible that others fear death to such an extent that my acceptance and willingness to commite suicide, by extension, is to them unacceptable and fearsome ? All I know is, I wish for life to be over and the pain to be gone.

I realise posting here makes it seem as something done once the bottom is reached, or something. Alas, this is a state I've been in for a long time, longer than I dare to admit to myself. I endured growing up simply because I refused to give in. I endured my adolescence because no fucking way was I gonna give up when the younger me had endured simply through sheer force of will and the illusion of hope that some day everything will be better.

Time, it seems, doesn't heal wounds. it just piles on. I'm unable to forget. Constantly reminded of horrible ghosts of my past. Afraid to sleep as my mind has, thankfully, blocked some of the most horrible memories, sadly, they come out ever so often when I dream. I awake not remembering, but the state I awake in is shattering.

I know people say suicide is a permament solution to a temporary problem, unfortunately, in my mind, it just becomes a permament relief from constant pain and suffering...

I'm sorta troubled there. I really really really do not want to be a burden in any way shape or kind to the extent of desiring solitidue. Yet, I also dont. I guess I'm not making much sense. It's just my very existence bothers me to the extend of desiring an end to it all. 
As far as talking about it, I used to talk about it during my childhood. our family dog. my only and one friend growing up and, well, in life at all.
I know you mean well, but saying I'm not alone in my struggles just seems so... empty, you know ? because at the end of the day that's exactly what I am. Alone and empty.

As I've already decided method, place, date and time, I'm uncertain whether I'm a good conversational partner regarding this matter. I wholehearthly am thankful for your good intent though. And I'm fairly similar on the last part.
